Rich only accepts new features that are first approved in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions), so please open this proposal there before this issue is worked on.

Part of this is already possible: `TaskProgressColumn(show_speed=True)` shows iterations per second, but only when `total` is unknown. For a custom unit such as rows or files, you can subclass [`ProgressColumn`](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/rich/progress.py) and render `task.finished_speed or task.speed` yourself.

Related earlier issue: #3835.
